measurements.template: Apliiq v5 designer, Sustainable Athletic Tee (ST720), transfer print, read 2026-10-14 at 20 px per inch from Apliiq's own garment base images (front view 4902, back view 4903)
measurements.front area starts: 2.40 in below the front collar seam at CF
measurements.back area starts: 0.20 in below the back collar seam at CB
measurements.front collar seam to back collar seam of: front seam sits 2.50 in lower than the back seam on Apliiq's template (y 252 px front vs 202 px back, same 590 x 900 canvas)
measurements.sizes: one print area and one placement for every size in the designer; each zone's production note pins the size and seam distance for S to XXL
measurements.fit check on S: big front 10.00 in inside the 14.00 in area and 5.00 in clear of each side seam on a 20 in chest; minimal GA centre 4.00 in left of CF, 4.50 in clear of the side seam

placements as saved.Minimal front: GA 3.00 x 2.70 in, centre 4.00 in to the wearer's left of CF, top 3.00 in below the front collar seam (0.60 in below the area top)
placements as saved.Minimal back: stacked lockup 6.00 x 2.26 in, centred, top 1.50 in below the back collar seam (1.30 in below the area top)
placements as saved.Big front: lockup 10.00 x 2.67 in, centred, top 3.00 in below the front collar seam (0.60 in below the area top)

swatches.Silver: #DDDFE1 in the Apliiq designer, lighter than the planning #A2AAAD, so the red A check does not trigger; the A reads clearly on the render

apliiq_designs.every design: transfer print, hi-res file linked (Apliiq 'final artwork', ideal quality), production note per zone, ST720 tear-away label, no private label

quotes.read: 2026-10-14 from the first saved design of each style (Black)
quotes.formula: (worst-size quote + $3 label + $1 fulfilment + $0.30 card fee) / 0.671, rounded up
